name: loop_slice_post_selection
description: Ledger row 3: after a band loop slice the reference additionally leaves the new loop's EDGES and VERTICES selected; we leave the sliced polygons only. Measured on a 3-segment unit cube where the two engines' slice GEOMETRY agrees exactly, so the divergence is isolated to the selection. On this base the selected POLYGON sets also agree exactly — the ledger's 'six of fourteen polygons differ' was seen on the pilot's patch and is NOT reproduced here, so this cell freezes the edge/vertex half of the row and deliberately claims nothing about the polygon half.
source: Reference half: the frozen wave-1 probe capture of the post-slice state (task 1120). vibe3d half: measured live against this tree. Ledger row: 3.

provenance.harness: tools/local/fixture_gen/cmd_divergence (task 1130), over the task-1120 headless probe capture
provenance.notes: Headless COMMAND capture — no display, no pointer injection, no gesture. Re-measured on a base both engines build from one command, because the pilot patch the ledger row was found on was never dumped. The reference's selection MODE did not read back in that capture and is therefore absent, not assumed.

cases.name: loop_edges_and_verts_there_polygons_only_here
cases.note: nine top faces of a 3-segment cube sliced at 0.65 with Slice Selected on: 66 verts / 127 edges / 63 faces on BOTH sides, and the reference additionally holds the new loop
